hero.title: Hospitality Management in Finland
hero.subtitle: Hospitality management is an excellent study option for students interested in hotel operations, tourism, restaurant management, event planning and international customer service. Hospitality Management in Finland combines business knowledge, practical learning and service-industry skills to prepare students for careers in hotels, resorts, restaurants, tourism companies and event organisations. Finnish universities of applied sciences offer English-taught programmes that focus on hospitality operations, service design, leadership, sustainability and customer experience.
